speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Must love wait for method?
premises: Neither the non-meditator nor the non-mutterer is barred: it may dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so — to Śiva's light, to the love-possessor — we bow.
inference: Rule-free dawn saluted: love needs no prior method.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: How does the self stay young?
premises: My self stays young, drinking Thy love-nectar.
Greyed only as if with road-dust — dust that is passion (rāga).
inference: Love-nectar keeps the self young; world-dust merely greys it.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of lovers' world-walking?
premises: For wealth-winners homed in Thy city — lovers —
even market-road walking is that same unfolding.
inference: The city-dweller's errands unfold as devotion.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Where is the lover's ground?
premises: Where world-in-world stands face to face with Thee —
nothing is not ground; no prayer fails.
inference: Thee-everywhere makes everywhere ritual ground.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who wins?
premises: The drunk on love-nectar-wine win.
Second to none, yet never without Thee beside — dvitīyāḥ double.
inference: Love-drunkards win: matchless, yet never Thee-less.
uncertainties: dvitīyāḥ holds predicative (second to none) and possessive (having-You-second); L3 keeps both.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who knows the bliss-sea Lord?
premises: Only the flooded know: thick-drenched in love-bliss-nectar.
inference: Knowing Him requires drowning.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What grounds love?
premises: Thou alone, self's Lord, art all beings' nature; all love within the self.
So love stands self-grounded (svabhāvasiddhā).
Knowing this by drowning (samāveśayuktyā) — let him conquer.
inference: Proof: self-nature loves self-nature; immersion-knowing conquers.
uncertainties: samāveśayuktyā via Kṣemarāja (by immersion's means); union-means reading equivalent — settled.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Where is He seen?
premises: Known destroyed — who would not see Thee standing all alone?
Even in known-knower churn, lovers find Thee easy (sudarśana).
inference: Past the known, He stands obvious; lovers find Him easy.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What love is asked?
premises: As the Goddess, bliss-lake, dearest, stands unparted from Thee —
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
inference: Unparted Goddess-love asked as the model.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What causes Him?
premises: For lovers, everything causes gaining Thee.
The knowing-road stands threefold: joy, sorrow, bewilderment.
inference: All roads lead in: joy, sorrow, bewilderment alike.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of bare knowing?
premises: From tasting love-nectar, Master —
even knowing's highest state turns unwine-sour (nāsava) in my mouth.
inference: Against love's taste, peak knowing sours to vinegar.
uncertainties: nāsava as un-wine (anti-wine answering v05's wine); vinegar-sense kept.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who knows the real?
premises: Those whose love-lore came as practice —
they alone know: knowing, unknowing, both.
inference: Practice-lovers alone know both knowing and unknowing.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of this speech?
premises: Speech-creeper from root, opening in order —
love-nectar-sprinkled — may its fruit sap-swell for me.
inference: Blessed speech prayed fruitful.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of becoming and sacrifice?
premises: 'Be Śiva, then sacrifice'; 'become, the lover' — so declared.
Thou alone art the body's pith, by lovers assayed in oneness.
inference: Becoming precedes rite; Thy body-pith assayed in oneness.
uncertainties: Lakshmanjoo witness: activity-embrace, not shunning — yaj kept as sacrifice.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What proves, what veils?
premises: For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness?
For the lowest, what but veils — heaped toward failure.
inference: All proves for lovers; veils heap for the lowest.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Is He gotten by yoga's where-when?
premises: 'Sometime, somewhere, by yoga got' — Lord, that's the cheat (vañcanā).
Else how blaze here in every state for lovers?
inference: Localization refused: He blazes in every state.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What sets lovers past yogins?
premises: Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — the great difference.
Love's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past yogins.
inference: Waking gatheredness: devotion's edge over yoga.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What is prescribed?
premises: No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule prescribed.
On the straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.
inference: No prescription but love praised.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What perishes?
premises: Cover fire-shattered all round by love's light-play —
I facing all things bare — may even thoughts perish.
inference: Cover burned, thoughts prayed to perish.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of the Name?
premises: One word Śiva camped on tongue-tip always — every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only — whatever that is — ah!
inference: The Name camped on tongue tastes all senses — lovers-only wonder.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who counts?
premises: In the calm-waved love-nectar sea — tasting otherworld sap, steady —
who is counted a nobody (anāma)?
inference: Sea-steady tasters: none a nobody.
uncertainties: anāma (no-name) as status-inversion; of-no-account reading kept.

option_choices.reason: L2 keeps the mystic register (the diver, not the dropout); the social reading survives as the live alternative — crux left open per C1 boundary, do not freeze.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Why not chew?
premises: Why would the likes of us not chew love's great herb?
Whose next taste is called freedom.
inference: The freedom-aftertaste herb urged chewed.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What counts as wealth?
premises: Those alone count wealth, by the good's measure —
whatever fattens trusted feasting on love's sap.
inference: Wealth redefined: what fattens love-feasting.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: Who stays unsmeared?
premises: Some love-nectar-pith caught — fallen in passion-mud and all —
come up unsmeared.
inference: Mud-fallen, nectar-caught: unsmeared ascent.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of powers?
premises: Powers to freedom — fruit a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some (keṣu cit).
inference: Powers reframed as limbs; fruition for some.

speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
question: What of the mind?
premises: Strange: mind pain-seed by nature (duḥkhabīja) —
love-sap-sprinkled, ripens to freedom's great fruit.
inference: Pain-seed mind, love-watered, fruits freedom.
